title: Mixed Event — Time to hang out♪ — Episode2 Shopping as Your Heart Pounds♪

meta.Episode: Episode2 — Shopping as Your Heart Pounds♪
meta.Event Outline: Upon hearing Minori's eagerness to ask An what it was like growing up with Haruka, Kohane suggests a day out for the four of them. On the day of, both Minori and Kohane learn the true depth of An and Haruka's friendship...

rows.Line: The day of
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait!
I had to help get our place ready to open.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Anyway, I've really been looking forward to today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too, Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, call me An.
I mean, we're here to have fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure?
I guess, um... An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Much better!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're at it, Azusawa, why don't we call each other on a first-name basis too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sure!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! R-Right...!
Thank you too, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Are you blushing, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel, Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's really cool and really cute on top of that...! I'm used to it now, but my heart raced the first time she called me by my first name.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that true?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So that means Kohane's heart must be pounding right now right...?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? Is that jealousy I'm sensing, An?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's not jealousy...
It's just, my singing should be the only thing that makes Kohane feel this way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, you're crushing me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're so close.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They really are.
Well, An's always been the friendly type, but this is the first time I've seen her be this close with someone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course we're close!
She's my partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's have as much fun as we can today, so shall we?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this coat's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You'd look great in it, Minori...!
This cardigan's really cute too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I can't decide. Everything this store has is so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place is full of clothes that suit the both of you, Minori, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Oh, Minori, this blouse might look really good on you. Here, try it on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sure, like this?
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it suits you really well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Thank you so much, Haruka...!
I'm gonna go take these up front!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome, but just like that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why not? I like your style, Haruka. You have an eye for these kinds of outfits.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane!
Try this shirt on!
I bet it'll look great on you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Absolutely adorable!
Not only does it look great on you, it goes perfectly with your current outfit!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what if you wore these boots and this skirt too? We can pick out a full outfit for you right here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, An, what about you...?
Don't you want to try anything on?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm more of a street fashion girl.
I usually get what I wear down on Main Street instead of at malls like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I chose this store because it looked so cute, but maybe that wasn't such a good idea since An's with us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we check out somewhere you like to go, An? I'm curious to see where you usually hang out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wanna go too!
We'd get to check out some clothes that we usually never get to see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I'd like to see where you like to go as well, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Alright, let's go!
It's over this way!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So this is where you find what to wear...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is! It's like these clothes are all meant for you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since we're here, why don't we all try on some stuff?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll start with... Oh, this dress!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mirror, mirror on the wall♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sort of...
Something just doesn't seem right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I think it looks really good on you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It may be because you're not used to seeing yourself in outfits like the one you're wearing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I understand how you feel, Minori. I have a hard time picturing myself wearing all the cool outfits that An wears...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's like I'm not mature enough or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! I feel the same way right now, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's like I'm not old enough to wear this, but want to find a way to fix that at the same time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two really believe that?
I don't see anything wrong from where I'm standing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm with her.
I like what you've chosen and your current outfits also suit you both really well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so happy! I don't know what to say...! I promise to keep this outfit forever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure they'll last that long...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, An, Haruka, do you see anything that you like?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure, I see a few things.
How about you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not really sure since it's all so different compared to what I usually wear...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, how about this shirt?
It should be easy to work into what you usually wear, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, that looks so cool...!
It suits her so well too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I agree completely!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you're all willing to say that much, then I guess I should try it on. Excuse me. I'd like to try this on...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna try some stuff on too. I'll take the stall next to yours!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so exciting...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ta-daah! All done!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't usually wear anything like this but... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You look sooo amazing, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I love what you usually wear, but this, you look way too cool in that outfit! It's true! You really do look good in anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you're exaggerating but... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You look really good too, An.
I wish I looked as good in that kind of outfit...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, this is one of my usual spots.
But I really appreciate the compliment, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And look at you, Haruka.
Talk about being stylish!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This may take some getting used to, but it might be nice to wear something like this every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look so incredible standing next to each other like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look really cool, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything okay, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, no, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You two look so cool in those outfits.
It's like you're models.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Me, a model?! No way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. But thank you for the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Why do I feel this way?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's this hazy feeling in my chest...?)
